lessons.title: Dinner Before the Deadline
lessons.goal: 利用開放時間與準備時間倒推行動。
lessons.story:
Sam promises to return a neighbor’s cake pan before seven tonight. His family also plans to eat dinner at six thirty. He thinks there is plenty of time and begins a computer game at five forty.

At six ten, his mother asks whether the pan is clean. Sam checks the kitchen and finds it beside the sink, still sticky. Washing and drying it takes fifteen minutes. The neighbor lives a ten-minute walk away.

Sam pauses the game, cleans the pan, and leaves at six twenty-five. He reaches the neighbor’s door at six thirty-five. The pan is returned on time, but Sam misses the beginning of dinner.

After eating, he changes tomorrow’s task list. Instead of writing only the final deadline, he adds the time needed to get ready and travel. He also leaves a little room for unexpected delays.

words.example: Sam promises to return the pan.
The pan is sticky after baking.
Leave some time for a delay.

questions.prompt: By what time does Sam promise to return the pan?
questions.explanation: 歸還承諾是七點前，不是開飯時間。
questions.evidence: Sam promises to return a neighbor’s cake pan before seven tonight.

questions.prompt: Why can’t Sam leave with the pan immediately at six ten?
options: It still needs washing and drying.
He must buy a new cake first.
The pan is locked in a classroom.
questions.explanation: 烤盤還黏黏的，需十五分鐘洗淨擦乾。
questions.evidence: Washing and drying it takes fifteen minutes.
reasons: 前句說 still sticky，後句給清潔時間。
鄰居仍住十分鐘路程外。

questions.prompt: When does Sam reach the neighbor?
questions.explanation: 六點二十五出發，走十分鐘，六點三十五到。
questions.evidence: He reaches the neighbor’s door at six thirty-five.

options: The number of people eating dinner.
The length of a computer game.
The place where a task begins.
The latest time by which a task must be finished.
questions.explanation: deadline 指任務必須完成的最後期限。
questions.evidence: Instead of writing only the final deadline, he adds the time needed to get ready and travel.
reasons: 與準備時間、交通時間並列的最終期限。

questions.prompt: Which statement about Sam’s evening is supported?
options: He keeps his return promise but starts dinner late.
He eats before leaving with the pan.
He stops planning because delays cannot be avoided.
He returns the pan after seven.
questions.explanation: 六點三十五歸還早於七點，但晚於六點半開飯。
questions.evidence: The pan is returned on time, but Sam misses the beginning of dinner.

questions.prompt: If Sam wants to be back by six thirty, when must he start the fifteen-minute cleaning at the latest? Assume ten minutes each way and no other delays.
questions.evidence: Washing and drying it takes fifteen minutes. The neighbor lives a ten-minute walk away.
